about: What a roofing contractor may change in the Keel & Ridge design. Protected: the scroll-run re-roof (the house, its eight layers, the camera, the weather and the storm test), the damage check's scoring, the estimate maths, the materials board and its close-up, the drive-time map and the booking flow, layout, type and all interaction code. The roofer's own words, materials, prices, colours, towns and booking windows come from the content.
rules: Text may not contain < > { } or line breaks.

stages: the eight stages of the re-roof the hero runs, in this order: inspection, tear-off, deck, underlayment, flashing, roofing, ridge, storm test. Each has a short name (n) and a caption (c) in the roofer's own words. The roofing and ridge captions describe the first material; every other material may give its own (lay, ridge).
issues: six short labels for the problems the inspection marks on the old roof, in this order: missing tabs, a cracked pipe boot, lifted shingles, rusted flashing, soft decking, algae streaks.

materials: one to three, each of a kind (asphalt shingles, standing-seam metal or cedar shake: the house and the close-up draw that kind), with the roofer's name for it, a short label, a blurb, lifespan, wind rating, warranty, weight, an installed price range per square (100 sq ft) and the colours stocked. Asphalt and cedar colours are four tones each (the blend of the shingles), metal colours one tone.

check.symptoms: the eight signs a homeowner can tick, one per id (missing, granules, curl, stain, sag, light, moss, hail), each with a label, a hint and what the roofer checks first. The scoring is the design's.

book.towns: the service area. The first is where the yard is (m 0, no dir); the rest each with drive minutes (5-45) and the compass direction from the yard (N, NNE, NE ... NNW). book.coast puts water on that side of the map (none inland).
book.slots: the arrival windows offered on a weekday, in order; book.saturday how many of them run on a Saturday (0: no Saturdays). Never Sundays.
